title: Myles Murphy: I understand why Bengals declined 2027 option, have to be at my best

sources.name: Pro Football Talk
sources.title: Myles Murphy: I understand why Bengals declined 2027 option, have to be at my best
sources.description: Edge rusher Myles Murphy set career highs for sacks, tackles and quarterback hits during the 2025 season, but his improvement wasn't enough to convince the Bengals to guarantee his return for the 2027 season.
